# `fatal_error_01`

MooreToCore lowered a `moore.class.new` whose class has a `!moore.string` property into an LLVM struct that still carried `!sim.dstring`, then asked MLIR's data layout for that member's size; MLIR answers an unanswerable data-layout query with `llvm::report_fatal_error`, so the tool printed `LLVM ERROR: neither the scoping op nor the type class provide data layout information for !sim.dstring` and aborted. It covers the `fatal_error` class, which 04-Test-Plan.md 5.1 predicts Source A will underproduce, and it is the class the ordering of 03-LLD.md 3.6.1 exists for: the process dies by `SIGABRT` exactly as an assertion does, and only the absence of an assertion line and the presence of the `LLVM ERROR:` line separate the two. It is also the set's only `out_of_scope_root` case: after the prologue strip the first surviving frame is MLIR's own `getDefaultTypeSizeInBits`, not CIRCT's, which is FR-07.5's predicate firing on real output rather than on a constructed one. And it is where 03-LLD.md 3.7.1's normalisation defect costs the most: this class's primary fingerprint is `signal + fingerprint_frame` and has no other basis, but the CIRCT frame that names the bug is `(anonymous namespace)::ClassNewOpConversion::matchAndRewrite`, whose normalisation cuts at the depth-zero `(` in `(anonymous namespace)` and yields the empty string, so the recorded `fingerprint_frame` is `main circt-opt.cpp` and would be that for every `fatal_error` the campaign produces. The real site is MooreToCore.cpp:895.

Mined by `analysis/measurements/w09_attempt.sh` on 2026-09-14 from seed `c3e2100d37ca` (`test/Conversion/MooreToCore/errors.mlir`), observed at its first parent `6fc9ee90ddad` built against `firtool-1.143.0`; the same input at the seed commit does not fire. Tool `circt-opt`, class `fatal_error`, signal `SIGABRT`.

`stderr.txt`, `expected.json:assertion_site` and the frame paths carry the mining host's build prefix (`/home/adi/.cache/chia-pin-smoke/w09/wt143` for CIRCT sources, `/home/adi/.cache/chia-pin-smoke/w09/sdk-1.143.0` for the SDK), not the image's `/workspace/circt/` and `/opt/circt-sdk/`. 03-LLD.md 3.7.1 strips the build prefix before the site enters a fingerprint, so the prefix is evidence and never a compared value; the relative site is ` lib/Conversion/MooreToCore/MooreToCore.cpp:895`.
